jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
## Who We Are

We don't just develop software; we build scalable products.

We develop Multi-Tenant SaaS infrastructures, microservices architectures, event-driven systems, and high-traffic integration platforms. Our products support a broad ecosystem consisting of e-commerce, payment systems, subscription management, customer engagement, notification infrastructures, and services tailored for various industries.

We are looking for a *Senior Backend Software Engineer* to join a team where code quality, software architecture, and sustainable system design are highly valued, and where technical decisions are truly made by engineers.

---

# Job Description

In this role, you will take an active part in processes such as:

•⁠ ⁠Developing microservices-based backend services.
•⁠ ⁠Architecture-level improvement of both new and existing services.
•⁠ ⁠Designing and developing event-driven systems.
•⁠ ⁠Developing third-party system integrations.
•⁠ ⁠Creating solutions focused on performance, security, and scalability.
•⁠ ⁠Conducting code reviews.
•⁠ ⁠Contributing to technical design processes.
•⁠ ⁠Establishing and implementing software standards.
•⁠ ⁠Providing technical mentorship to Junior and Mid-level developers.

---

# Technical Skills Required

### Advanced Level

•⁠ ⁠C#
•⁠ ⁠.NET
•⁠ ⁠ASP.NET Core
•⁠ ⁠REST API development
•⁠ ⁠Microservices Architecture
•⁠ ⁠Clean Architecture
•⁠ ⁠SOLID Principles
•⁠ ⁠Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
•⁠ ⁠Design Patterns
•⁠ ⁠Dependency Injection
•⁠ ⁠CQRS
•⁠ ⁠MediatR or similar architectures
•⁠ ⁠Event-Driven Architecture
•⁠ ⁠Asynchronous Programming
•⁠ ⁠JWT Authentication & Authorization
•⁠ ⁠Docker
•⁠ ⁠Git

---

### Intermediate to Advanced Level

•⁠ ⁠Redis
•⁠ ⁠Message Brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
•⁠ ⁠Distributed Cache
•⁠ ⁠Distributed Lock
•⁠ ⁠Background Worker services
•⁠ ⁠Scheduler systems
•⁠ ⁠API Gateway
•⁠ ⁠Swagger / OpenAPI
•⁠ ⁠Elasticsearch
•⁠ ⁠Kubernetes
•⁠ ⁠CI/CD processes

---

### Database Knowledge

We expect strong experience in at least one of the following technologies:

•⁠ ⁠SQL Server
•⁠ ⁠PostgreSQL
•⁠ ⁠MongoDB

Additionally, the following are highly valued:

•⁠ ⁠Writing high-performance queries
•⁠ ⁠Indexing structures
•⁠ ⁠Transaction management
•⁠ ⁠Data modeling
•⁠ ⁠Experience working with Big Data

---

# Software Engineering Expectations

We expect you to be experienced in the following areas:

•⁠ ⁠Clean Code
•⁠ ⁠SOLID
•⁠ ⁠Refactoring
•⁠ ⁠Domain-Driven Design (DDD) approach
•⁠ ⁠Testable software development
•⁠ ⁠Code readability
•⁠ ⁠Performance optimization
•⁠ ⁠Security-oriented development
•⁠ ⁠Logging
•⁠ ⁠Monitoring
•⁠ ⁠Error Handling
•⁠ ⁠High Availability
•⁠ ⁠Scalability

---

# What Will Make You Stand Out

•⁠ ⁠Experience working on Multi-Tenant SaaS projects.
•⁠ ⁠Experience developing large-scale microservices architectures.
•⁠ ⁠Experience developing Event-Driven systems.
•⁠ ⁠Experience developing financial systems.
•⁠ ⁠Payment gateway integrations.
•⁠ ⁠E-commerce systems.
•⁠ ⁠ERP integrations.
•⁠ ⁠Marketplace integrations.
•⁠ ⁠Real-time, high-traffic systems.
•⁠ ⁠Production experience in a Kubernetes environment.
•⁠ ⁠Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

---

# What We Expect From You

•⁠ ⁠A level of software expertise sufficient to make architectural and technical decisions.
•⁠ ⁠High problem-solving skills.
•⁠ ⁠A strong interest in software architecture.
•⁠ ⁠Accountability and ownership.
•⁠ ⁠Strong aptitude for teamwork.
•⁠ ⁠Openness to continuous learning and research.
•⁠ ⁠Ability to manage technical debt.
•⁠ ⁠A product-oriented mindset.

---

# What Awaits You Here?

•⁠ ⁠A modern technology stack.
•⁠ ⁠Microservices architecture.
•⁠ ⁠Event-driven systems.
•⁠ ⁠Large-scale backend development.
•⁠ ⁠Direct participation in technical decision-making processes.
•⁠ ⁠A say in architectural design processes.
•⁠ ⁠Opportunities to work on continuously evolving products.
•⁠ ⁠A technical team composed of highly experienced engineers.
•⁠ ⁠A development culture that prioritizes code quality.
•⁠ ⁠A working environment where you can experiment with new technologies.

---

# Technology Stack

•⁠ ⁠.NET

## How to Apply

If you are a Backend Software Engineer who does not just build APIs, but also:

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra
enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.
Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

What You'll Do

Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.
Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.
Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.
Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).
Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.
Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).
Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).
Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.
Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.
University degree in Computer Science or any related field.
Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

Benefits & Perks 🎁

Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).
Flexible working hours.
Health and life insurance program.
Learning & development budget.
Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply!
We’d love to hear from you!

All applications will be treated with confidentiality. Please note that due to the high volume of CVs received, only candidates who are a good fit will be contacted for an interview.

As part of our commitment to diversity in the workforce, Infiterra is dedicated to Equal Employment Opportunity, ensuring that all individuals are treated with respect and consideration without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

jobs.title: Master's Thesis - AI Innovation Engineer Intern (12 months contract)
jobs.description:
Your team

PWM Customized Solutions team enables business innovation within Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) by helping business users leverage modern technologies, including AI, low-code platforms, and data solutions. The team acts as a bridge between business needs and technology teams, delivering or enabling innovative and compliant solutions that create tangible business value.

Internship Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated student to join the Customized Solutions team for a 12-month internship focused on the design and implementation of PWM's next-generation Agentic AI Platform.

This strategic initiative aims to provide business users with secure, scalable, and governed AI agents capable of supporting knowledge discovery, process automation, decision support, and productivity enhancement across PWM.

The intern will contribute to both the research and implementation aspects of the platform, combining academic work with practical delivery in a real-world banking environment.

Your role

Agentic AI Platform Strategy and Architecture

Evaluate emerging AI agent technologies, frameworks, and patterns.
Collaborate with business, IT, security, and data teams to define requirements.
Support the design of secure, scalable, and reusable platform components.

Governance and Risk Management

Identify policies, standards, and control mechanisms for responsible AI adoption.
Help define monitoring, auditability, security, and compliance requirements.
Research best practices related to AI governance in highly regulated environments.

Platform Implementation

Participate in the development and configuration of AI agents.
Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts addressing real business use cases.
Integrating AI capabilities with enterprise data sources and business applications.

Research and Innovation

Conduct academic research related to agentic AI systems and enterprise AI platforms.
Evaluate industry trends and benchmark solutions adopted within the financial services sector.
Translate research findings into practical recommendations and platform improvements.

Expected Deliverables

Design recommendations for the PWM Agentic AI Platform architecture.
AI governance framework proposals and implementation guidelines.
Prototypes of AI agents addressing business use cases and technical documentation.

Your profile

Education

Computer Science or Software Engineering
Artificial Intelligence
Data Science
Or a related discipline

Technical Skills

Understanding AI and LLMs.
Knowledge of software architecture concepts.
Familiarity with cloud technologies, APIs, and programming languages.

Personal Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Autonomous, organized, and collaborative mindset.

What the Intern Will Gain

Hands-on experience building an enterprise-grade AI platform in a leading private bank.
Exposure to cutting-edge Agentic AI technologies and governance practices.
Opportunity to collaborate with experts across technology, security, data, and business domains.
Ability to transform academic research into tangible business impact.
Participate in a highly strategic initiative shaping the future use of AI within Wealth Management.

Start date: February / March 2027

Ref: MTCS/RS/LMM

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
